attempt: fine discrete sweep, 0.5 GHz, same design as the 1 GHz reference run
error_detail: export failed: E_SWEEP_EXPORT_INCOMPLETE: touchstone for sweep 'ANT_Band' has 1 row(s) after 3 attempt(s); refusing to report a bandwidth
invariant: a sweep that has not finished exporting must be refused, not turned into a bandwidth
interpretation: the 13-point discrete sweep did not finish exporting inside the measurement window; the guard refused with E_SWEEP_EXPORT_INCOMPLETE instead of reporting a one-row bandwidth. The A/B therefore moves to an interpolating sweep, which resolves the band without paying for 13 discrete solves.
